description: This PHP class 'MenuDao' provides data access methods for menu items within the OrangeHRM system, including enabling/disabling menu items, retrieving menu items by module and screen, and constructing hierarchical menu structures based on user roles.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for menu items, handling database operations related to menu management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specific module, optionally filtered by menu titles.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Private method to update the status (enable/disable) of menu items for a module, optionally filtered by menu titles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item based on module name and screen name.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches top-level menu items for the side panel based on user roles.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves second-level menu items and their third-level children for a given side menu item, filtered by user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper for menu items filtered by user roles and permissions.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Fetches a menu item by its title, optionally filtered by level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a module entity by its name.
